# Kagurabachi Manga — kagurabachimanga.online

## About
Kagurabachi Manga is a fan reading platform dedicated to the manga series "Kagurabachi" (カグラバチ) by Takeru Hokazono. The site provides free access to high-quality English scans of all available chapters.

## Manga Info
- Title: Kagurabachi
- Author: Takeru Hokazono
- Publisher: Shueisha (Weekly Shōnen Jump)
- Serialization Start: September 19, 2023
- Status: Ongoing
- Genre: Action, Dark Fantasy, Shounen, Supernatural, Revenge
- Award: 10th Next Manga Award — Print Category
- Synopsis: Chihiro Rokuhira, son of the legendary swordsmith Kunishige Rokuhira, embarks on a revenge quest against the Hishaku sorcerers who murdered his father and stole his enchanted blades.

## Key Characters
- Chihiro Rokuhira — protagonist, wielder of the Enchanted Blade Enten
- Hakuri Sazanami — ally and fellow swordsman
- Char Shinuchi — antagonist, leader of the Hishaku
